name: axis_formats
description: A response-time plot using date-and-time axis formatting. Judge only content inside the plot; ignore tabs, format controls, headings, descriptions, buttons, and other surrounding UI.

checks.expectation: One coherent response-time plot is visible. Its axes, grid, and curve stay within the plot area without unintended overlap or clipping. Do not evaluate tabs, format controls, or other content outside the plot.

The horizontal Trace time axis shows clock-formatted labels progressing from about 09:30:00 to 09:31:00 rather than raw millisecond values. The Response time (ms) vertical axis is also present. If the screenshot resolution is insufficient to read the exact tick text, report uncertain; do not fail solely because the labels are small or blurred.
A continuous response-time curve with multiple variations and two prominent bursts is visible across the plotting area. Exact raster shape and minor sampling differences are acceptable.

Within the plot, axis titles and tick labels are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with headings, tabs, buttons, controls, or any text outside the plot. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.
The plot, grid, ticks, curve, and plot text are visually distinguishable; no plot element is blank, corrupted, or materially clipped.
